component.name: rgplayer
component.summary: A fast, modern, keyboard-driven Linux media player

description.p: rgplayer is a fast, clean-room Linux media player built on Qt 6 (QML) and libmpv. It combines modern dark aesthetics with power-user playback controls inspired by classic desktop players.

ul.li: Hardware-accelerated video decoding (VA-API, NVDEC) via libmpv.
Minimalist dark interface with auto-hiding gradient overlay controls.
Precision seeking with hover thumbnail previews.
A-B loop repetition, variable speed, and frame stepping.
Seamless MPRIS2 desktop integration for system media keys and player applets.

description.p: Initial release of rgplayer featuring libmpv playback, modern QML UI, hover thumbnails, and MPRIS2 integration.
